hero.headline: MUJ Online MBA in Operations Management: Syllabus, Fees and Career Outcomes
hero.sub: UGC-DEB approved Super/Dual specialization. 13 spec subjects in Sem 3-4. NAAC A+, NIRF University #58.

sections.tldr: MUJ Online MBA in Operations Management covers production and operations, ERP, logistics and supply chain, operations research, services operations, total quality management, and production planning for professionals targeting plant management or operations director roles. Super/Dual spec, pair with Supply Chain or Analytics.

about.body:
Operations Management is the MBA specialization for professionals who manage the physical and process core of organisations: plant managers, production supervisors, logistics heads, and operations analysts targeting VP Operations, COO, or manufacturing director roles. The MUJ Online MBA in Operations Management covers the full operations scope with 13 spec subjects across Sem 3-4: production planning, ERP, logistics and supply chain, operations research, services operations, and total quality management.

MUJ's Super/Dual specialization allows Operations Management students to pair this spec with Supply Chain Management (for end-to-end supply chain leadership), Analytics and Data Science (for data-driven operations and Industry 4.0 roles), or Project Management (for EPC and infrastructure operations roles). The dual credential strengthens the candidate's profile for cross-functional leadership positions.

Manipal University Jaipur Online is NAAC A+ accredited with NIRF University #58 for 2025. EdifyEdu verifies accreditation data independently and does not receive commission from MUJ. Full programme overview at /universities/manipal-university-jaipur-online/mba.

subjects.name: Strategic Management
subjects.description: Operations strategy, competitive priorities, and linking production decisions to business strategy.

subjects.name: Term Paper
subjects.description: Independent research paper applying operations management theory to a real-world manufacturing or service challenge.

subjects.name: Production and Operations Management
subjects.description: Facility layout, aggregate production planning, capacity management, scheduling, and productivity improvement.

subjects.name: Enterprise Resource Planning
subjects.description: ERP architecture, SAP and Oracle modules relevant to manufacturing, and integration of production data.

subjects.name: Logistics and Supply Chain Management
subjects.description: Supply chain network design, logistics operations, warehousing strategy, and transportation management.

subjects.name: Operations Research
subjects.description: Linear programming, queuing theory, simulation, and quantitative decision-making methods for operations.

subjects.name: Project
subjects.description: Major dissertation applying operations management learning to an original applied business study.

subjects.name: Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP)
subjects.description: Advanced ERP configuration, multi-plant deployment, MRP and MPS implementation, and ERP-driven process optimization.

subjects.name: Services Operations Management
subjects.description: Service delivery design, capacity planning for service industries, and customer experience operations management.

subjects.name: Total Quality Management
subjects.description: TQM philosophy, Six Sigma DMAIC, ISO 9001, Kaizen, and quality system implementation in manufacturing and services.

**Mid-level roles:** Plant Manager, Operations Manager, Supply Chain Manager, Quality Head, Logistics Manager

**Senior roles:** VP Operations, Director of Manufacturing, COO, Head of Supply Chain, Plant Director

Online batches are often reported apart from campus ones, or not at all. edifyedu.in does not publish employer lists it cannot source. skills.body:
The Operations Management specialization builds skills that manufacturing and industrial employers test at plant manager and operations director levels:

- Production Planning: MRP and MPS systems, aggregate production planning, capacity constraint management, and OEE improvement
- Total Quality Management: Six Sigma DMAIC methodology, SPC charts, ISO 9001 audit management, and Kaizen event facilitation
- ERP Operations: SAP PP and MM module configuration, production order management, and plant maintenance system administration
- Supply Chain: inventory optimisation, distribution network design, vendor performance management, and inbound logistics coordination

- Operational Research: LP model formulation for scheduling and resource allocation, simulation modelling for capacity planning
- Services Operations: service level design, waiting line management, and customer experience metrics for service industry operations

**Soft skills:** Managing unionised shop-floor workforces, presenting OEE and quality data to plant boards, building cross-functional consensus for ERP rollouts and lean transformation programmes.

certificate.body: The Manipal University Jaipur degree certificate carries the Manipal University Jaipur name, the MBA designation, and identifies the online learning mode per UGC-DEB 2020 regulations. The Operations Management specialisation is noted on the marksheet and transcript. The certificate names the online mode, as UGC-DEB rules require. It counts the same as a regular MBA for jobs, promotions and further study.

faqs.question: Can I choose dual specialization with the MUJ Online MBA?
faqs.answer: Yes. For Operations Management, strong pairings include: Operations plus Supply Chain Management (for end-to-end supply chain leadership), Operations plus Analytics and Data Science (for Industry 4.0 and data-driven operations), or Operations plus Project Management (for EPC and infrastructure project operations roles).

faqs.question: Is this MBA useful for manufacturing engineers transitioning to management?
faqs.answer: Yes. This is the primary use case for Operations Management MBA. Engineers transitioning from production or quality roles use this degree to qualify for plant manager, operations head, and VP Operations positions that require a formal management credential. The production planning, TQM, and ERP content builds directly on manufacturing experience. Engineers with 5-10 years of plant experience typically get the most immediate return from this qualification.

chooseIf: You are a production engineer, plant manager, or operations professional in manufacturing targeting plant director or VP Operations roles that require a management degree.
You can pair Operations with Supply Chain or Analytics for a cross-functional operations credential using MUJ's Super/Dual specialization.
consider: You need the strongest manufacturing management brand for MNC plant director roles, NMIMS Operations or Amity Production and Operations carry stronger recognition at multinational manufacturers.
You are in service operations rather than manufacturing, verify whether the services operations subjects cover your specific sector adequately.
